powerGrid.caption: Marvel's grid has six fixed axes and none for rewriting reality. Loki's power as the God of Stories in the comics, rewriting his own story (Loki: Agent of Asgard, 2014 to 2015), sits outside it: the grid does not measure it.

powerOrigins.detail: Born a Frost Giant of Jotunheim and raised in Asgard by Odin; his race gives him great strength, dense tough tissue and a very long life.
Extensive training in sorcery powers his energy blasts, illusions, shapeshifting, teleportation and enchantments.

abilities.name: Sorcery
abilities.detail: Ranked equal to Karnilla, Asgard's most skilled sorceress: mystic energy blasts, durable force fields and telekinesis.

abilities.name: Illusions
abilities.detail: Casts illusions strong enough to fool whole cities and mighty beings such as Surtur.

abilities.name: Shapeshifting
abilities.detail: Can become almost any animal, person or object, though copying a being's look does not give him its powers.

abilities.name: Teleportation
abilities.detail: Moves himself or others across great distances and between dimensions.

abilities.name: Psionics
abilities.detail: Projects his thoughts telepathically, even across dimensional barriers, and has potent hypnotic powers.

abilities.name: Frost Giant physique
abilities.detail: Can lift about 50 tons unaided; tissue roughly three times human density makes him far tougher than he looks.

abilities.name: Master schemer
abilities.detail: A genius strategist and manipulator who works through pawns and keeps winning back trust despite his crimes.

abilities.name: Enchantment
abilities.detail: Can bring objects to life and lend temporary superhuman powers to others, as he did for criminals like Cobra.

feats.text: Willed a leaf into Heimdall's eye to escape his tree prison, then panicked a city with a spell and hypnotised Thor into setting down Mjolnir.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Journey Into Mystery Vol 1 85

feats.text: Projected his mind from an Asgardian prison to Earth and framed the Hulk with an illusion, a scheme that brought the Avengers together.
Seized the Norn Stones and used them to empower the Avengers enough to wound the Void, who killed him for it.
Killed Laufey with a single blast from Gungnir, then blasted Thor through a wall.
Arrived through a Tesseract portal, shrugged off S.H.I.E.L.D. gunfire and took control of Hawkeye and Selvig with the Scepter.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: The Avengers

feats.text: Destroyed Kurse with a black hole grenade, then faked his own death with an illusion and slipped back to Asgard in disguise.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Thor: The Dark World
